required_contracts.ROM_matvec: Accept only WSRC0; preserve actual X-address stalls and registered root ordering. Completion includes every output VM write commit.
required_contracts.native_attention: Accept PCs11/13 from actual instruction bits and token position. Read actual Q/K/V, write actual S/M and ATT; preserve four Q heads sharing one KV head and golden reduction order. Report accepted operation, ready, idle, progress and faults to ME controller.
required_contracts.SU64: Use actual VM operands, coefficient/RoPE ROM and exact rounding; advance progress only after actual published VM/reduction outputs. PCs12/14/15 remain SU-owned unless explicit replacement binds equivalent effects to instruction retirement.
required_contracts.KV_formatter: Buffer non-stallable SU vector writes; drained means receiver memory commits including partial V sector flush, not just enqueue or transmission. PCs11/13 wait for prior K/V commits.
required_contracts.TP8_collective: At PCs17/24 drain both units and KV writes, reduce actual 256-word T1 vector in golden rank order, publish all return VM writes before next segment starts.
required_contracts.layer_completion: At PC26 require all arithmetic, mutable writes, collective returns and link credits drained; this image omits embedding/lm_head and does not prove a token.
